# ATHAM preview APK

`ATHAM-0.1.1.apk` is the current debug build. Install it from the GitHub Releases page.

Package id: `com.vagell.kv4pht.atham`. It installs next to the Play Store kv4p HT app and does not replace it.

On the phone: download the APK, open it, and allow install from your browser or file manager if Android asks. The launcher name is ATHAM.

This build opens the ATHAM shell: Home, Radio, Log, and Modules. KV4P Classic is inside the app for the existing voice and APRS screens. Connect, tune, scan, and PTT use the existing KV4P service when a radio is plugged in. Transmit still requires a license and a connected KV4P HT.
